brand.name: Innovation Artist Escort
brand.division: A division of Innovation Business Development Solutions

hero.headline: We move the people the world is
hero.subhead: Artist transport, elite creative spaces, venue logistics, and full event facilitation, orchestrated end to end, executed in silence.

contact.responseNote: We respond privately, usually within the hour during active hours.
contact.region: Full operational coverage across New York and New Jersey.
contact.confidentiality: Non-disclosure is standard on every engagement. Principal details, schedules, and locations are never shared, sold, or discussed outside the assigned team.

standard.title: Every client receives elite treatment, regardless of status.
standard.body: You don't have to be famous to move like the world is watching. Executives, founders, creators, and private individuals get the same meticulous itinerary and the same absolute discretion, day or night, exactly as directed.

mission.title: We don't chase profit. We pursue excellence.
mission.body: Talent is distributed evenly; opportunity is not. A share of what every engagement earns is directed back toward opening these doors for someone who has not walked through one yet. Motivation is the qualification.
mission.quote: Everyone deserves a chance and an opportunity. Some of them just need the room first.

scale.label: Venue capacity
scale.detail: From intimate rooms to arena-tier events.

scale.label: Regional command
scale.detail: Full operational coverage, vendor relationships to match.

scale.label: Rapid response
scale.detail: Small events facilitated in as little as twenty-four hours.

scale.label: Large-scale runway
scale.detail: Recommended lead time for large engagements.

process.title: Request
process.body: You send a request with the date, the city, and what you need handled.

process.title: Intake
process.body: We return a private intake form that captures the full scope: services, timing, and specifics.

process.title: Evaluation
process.body: We evaluate the assignment and confirm the right people, on board and secured for your dates.

process.title: Individual Briefs
process.body: Each team member receives a specific brief for the exact function they provide.

process.title: Confirmation
process.body: We confirm the full plan with you by email: scope, people, and timing, in writing.

process.title: Deposit & Lock
process.body: A deposit locks your dates and puts the engagement into motion. From here, we run it.

collections.title: Everything around the artist, run by one operation.
collections.intro: Six coordinated disciplines. One accountable team. Booked together or built to the night.

collections.title: Digital presence. Real-world support.
collections.intro: For creators, streamers, and public-facing talent, where an online following becomes an in-person moment.

collections.title: Rooms worthy of the work you make.
collections.intro: Private, protected, production-ready environments, provisioned to spec and supervised from load-in to lock-up.

collections.title: The entire stay, anywhere in the world.
collections.intro: Flights, accommodations, and daily movements, handled with the discretion you expect at home.

services.title: Full Engagement
services.summary: Everything handled: transport, spaces, venue, and facilitated detail through a single accountable lead.
services.body: One advance team, one run-of-show, one invoice. Routes, entrances, contingencies, and a written run-of-show locked before anyone moves. You approve it; we run it.

services.title: Artist Transport
services.tagline: Door to door, on the second
services.summary: Discreet, vetted ground movement: sedans, SUVs, and motorcade-grade convoys.
services.body: Discreet, vetted ground movement: sedans, SUVs, and motorcade-grade convoys with primary and alternate routes. Professional drivers, timed arrivals, clean hand-offs from wheels-up to stage.

services.title: Itinerary & Detail Management
services.summary: A minute-by-minute itinerary built around your principal.
services.body: A minute-by-minute itinerary built around your principal, exactly as directed. Every appointment, hold, and movement is sequenced, briefed, and adjusted live.

services.title: Flight & Transport Retrieval
services.summary: Private and commercial flight coordination with curbside-to-cabin retrieval.
services.body: Private and commercial flight coordination with curbside-to-cabin retrieval. Luggage, customs, and onward ground are arranged in advance. The principal lands and simply moves.

services.title: Venue Facilitation
services.summary: The room is ready before the talent moves.
services.body: Private load-in, closed green rooms, controlled access, perimeter coordination, back-of-house flow. Set, sealed, and run to spec, away from the crowd.

services.title: End-to-End Event Facilitation
services.summary: Concept, permits, vendors, staffing, transport, and the room: one discreet timeline.
services.body: One advance team, one run-of-show, one invoice. Concept, permits, vendors, staffing, transport, and the room: one discreet timeline from private arrivals to clean departures. Small events can be facilitated in as little as twenty-four hours; large engagements are best planned thirty to sixty days out.

services.title: Secure Detail Facilitation
services.summary: Vetted, licensed protective partners, coordinated through one point of contact.
services.body: We coordinate and deploy vetted, licensed protective partners: close detail, perimeter, and crowd management, from a single guarded door to a full motorcade. IAE orchestrates; accredited specialists execute.
services.note: IAE is not a security or protective-services firm and does not directly provide guards or armed personnel. When requested, IAE coordinates accredited, licensed protective partners on your behalf.

services.title: Festival & Convention Escort
services.summary: Coordinated entrances, exits, and backstage transitions through conventions, festivals, and expos.
services.body: From artist alley to main stage, IAE Elite moves with you through conventions, festivals, and expos: coordinated entrances, exits, and backstage transitions through some of the most unpredictable crowd environments in the public eye.

services.title: Live Streaming & Public Content Support
services.summary: A steady presence around the shot, not in it.
services.body: While you're live and creating in public, IAE Elite manages the space around you: holding position, absorbing interruptions, and keeping the environment calm so your focus stays on the stream.

services.title: Controlled Fan Interaction
services.summary: Meet-and-greets, photos, and autographs, organized with warmth, not walls.
services.body: Meet-and-greets, photos, autographs, and the moments in between, organized with warmth, not walls. IAE Elite keeps interactions respectful, orderly, and on your terms, so every fan encounter stays positive on both sides.

services.title: Crowd Management & Movement Coordination
services.summary: Organized movement through lines, gathering areas, and transitions.
services.body: Organized movement through lines, gathering areas, and transitions between locations: read ahead, planned around, and adjusted live.
services.note: IAE Elite provides coordination and facilitation, not licensed security. Where an assignment calls for regulated protective services, those are arranged through appropriately licensed partners.

services.title: Discreet Everyday Escort
services.summary: Low-profile accompaniment for meetings, dining, shopping, nightlife, or shoots.
services.body: Not every appearance needs a visible presence. For meetings, dining, shopping, nightlife, or content shoots, IAE Elite offers low-profile accompaniment built to support without standing out: professional company, without the production.

services.title: Travel & Tour Escort
services.summary: Continuity across multi-city schedules and back-to-back appearances.
services.body: Multi-city schedules, back-to-back appearances, and the logistics between them: airport transitions, hotel arrivals, venue departures, and everything in between. One coordinated thread from city to city.

services.title: Content & Video
services.summary: Cycloramas, blackout stages, and dressed locations with a closed perimeter.
services.body: Cycloramas, blackout stages, and dressed locations with power, rigging, and a closed perimeter. Shoot with no one in frame but your team.

services.title: Music & Recording
services.summary: Treated rooms and tracking suites on your hours.
services.body: Treated rooms and tracking suites on your hours: engineers, session security, and after-hours access, so the take never gets rushed.

services.title: Podcast & Broadcast
services.summary: Multi-cam podcast sets and live-stream capability, staffed and supervised.
services.body: Multi-cam podcast sets, live-stream capability, and greenroom flow. Staffed and supervised, guests timed and screened at the door.

services.title: Meetings & Corporate
services.summary: Boardrooms, pitch spaces, and executive floors booked discreetly.
services.body: Boardrooms, pitch spaces, and executive floors booked discreetly: signage suppressed, catering handled, guest list held at reception.

services.title: Social & Celebrations
services.summary: Launches, listening sessions, dinners, and milestone nights.
services.body: Launches, listening sessions, dinners, milestone nights. Room dressed, timeline run, departures cleared before the crowd forms.

services.title: Private Gatherings
services.tagline: Closed to all but your list
services.summary: Estates, penthouses, and members-only rooms that never appear anywhere.
services.body: Estates, penthouses, and members-only rooms for gatherings that never appear anywhere. Staffed, stocked, swept, closed to all but your list.

services.title: Flights & Retrieval
services.summary: Flight coordination with curbside-to-cabin retrieval at either end.
services.body: Private and commercial flight coordination with curbside-to-cabin retrieval at either end. Customs, luggage, and onward ground arranged in advance, so you simply arrive.

services.title: Residences & Suites
services.summary: Vetted private residences, suites, and estates secured to your standard.
services.body: Vetted private residences, suites, and estates secured to your standard: staffed, stocked, and made ready before you land, in any city you choose.

services.title: The Stay, End to End
services.summary: Your itinerary held and adjusted live: dining, meetings, leisure, movement.
services.body: Weekend or season, your itinerary is held and adjusted live: dining, meetings, leisure, movement. One seamless, private engagement.

requestOptions.disclaimer: Your request opens pre-filled in Mail. Review it and press Send. We never share principal details.
